strict_root_classification.reason: Pressure garment therapy remains the active mechanical intervention through the measured treatment window; the root does not provide off-compression persistence or a renewed adverse challenge, and it does not resolve myofibroblast EXIT mode.

The aortic constriction is physically removed and remains removed; reverse remodeling is followed for 2/4/6 weeks, but there is no reloading challenge and no lineage-resolved activated-fibroblast exit route. Incomplete normalization is retained but is not by itself proof of hysteresis.

A one-time capsule release improves ROM/max extension at 1 week, while stiffness/contracture partially returns by 3 weeks and connective-tissue density rises again. This directly distinguishes rescue from durable future-state rewrite.

external_calibration_roots.paper: Gradually softening hydrogels for modeling hepatic stellate cell behavior during fibrosis regression
external_calibration_roots.evidence: Mechanically primed HSCs partially revert over 14 days after ~20 to ~3 kPa softening, but rapidly reacquire myofibroblast features after re-stiffening to diseased-liver stiffness.

external_calibration_roots.paper: Redirecting Valvular Myofibroblasts into Dormant Fibroblasts through Light-mediated Reduction in Substrate Modulus
external_calibration_roots.evidence: 32 to 7 kPa in-situ softening rapidly downregulates alpha-SMA/CTGF and reduces activated morphology; deactivated cells remain capable of reactivation under growth/TGF-beta stimulation.

external_calibration_roots.paper: Nuclear mechanosensing drives chromatin remodelling in persistently activated fibroblasts
external_calibration_roots.evidence: Myofibroblasts exposed to stiff matrix for 1-3 days deactivate after softening; 7-day stiff exposure produces persistent activation that remains after 2-6 days of softening.

external_calibration_roots.paper: Soft substrate priming erases fibrotic mechanical memory in mesenchymal stromal cells via YAP lysosomal degradation to improve therapeutic efficacy for spinal cord injury
external_calibration_roots.evidence: Soft priming promotes YAP cytoplasmic retention/lysosomal degradation and makes transplanted MSCs more refractory to future stiffness-induced fibrotic conversion in the chronic SCI environment.
